statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold while Stress stays elevated on the scheduled 14:00Z catalyst stack.
recommendation: Conditions are described as contained and two-way ahead of the Warsh keynote. The narrow danger window spans 13:30Z-15:30Z, covering the U.S. cash open, Chicago PMI and the keynote reaction. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ still holds the same contained overnight range under Thursday's Nvidia-led close, with the 14:00Z Warsh keynote as the decisive checkpoint
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Thursday at 29,641.56, up 1.43% and effectively at the session high of 29,643.53, after Nvidia rose 8.74% on record quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion. Into the late European morning NQ futures trade near 29,618, about 0.26% lower, and are still inside the identical 29,578.25-29,707.00 range recorded several hours earlier: the range has not widened, price has retraced back up through it, and no new session extreme has been set. That is two-way structure, not the persistent one-way path that Tail measures, so Tail is held at 11. Cross-assets give no confirming stress: VIX is 14.50 and essentially unchanged, WTI is near $83.11 and Brent near $88.09 with both slightly lower, and Treasury futures are close to flat with 2Y and 10Y constant-maturity yields last published at 4.19% and 4.66%. Index futures show rotation rather than broad de-risking, with the Dow contract about 0.2% higher and the S&P 500 contract flat against NQ's 0.26% decline; Marvell trades about 1.5% lower in the pre-market after falling more than 7% post-earnings despite beating on revenue and guidance, which keeps semiconductors as the main index swing factor. Stress is raised to 54 for the concentrated 14:00Z catalyst stack: Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote as Fed Chair, the BLS preliminary benchmark revision to nonfarm payroll employment and the final August Michigan survey all land in the same hour, preceded by Chicago PMI at 13:45Z. Pre-event survey work points to a wide distribution of expected tones, which raises Stress and caps Confidence rather than raising Tail; a rates-first repricing with a delayed equity second leg remains the credible conditional escalation mechanism and is carried in the 14:00Z and 15:00Z forecast hours rather than in the current score. Confidence is 88 on current verified levels, yields, oil, volatility and a verified calendar.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON state with Tail between 10 and 14 and Stress between 45 and 54. Two hours late in Thursday's U.S. session were scored trend-up as the Nvidia-driven advance carried the index to a close at 29,641.56 near the day's high. Overnight and through the European morning the mode reverted to mixed as futures gave back part of that move inside a contained range, with Stress drifting up from 45 to the low 50s as the Jackson Hole catalyst stack approached. One hour, 10:00Z on 28 August, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon splits into three phases. Through 12:00Z the base case is continued two-way trade inside the overnight range with Stress rising on pre-event positioning. From 13:00Z to 15:00Z the U.S. cash open, Chicago PMI at 13:45Z and the 14:00Z keynote stack form the highest-risk stretch, peaking at the 14:00Z hour where the mapped policy state is WATCH; a delayed rates-first second leg is carried as a real conditional path rather than an observed one. From 16:00Z conditional risk decays on the assumption that price discovery is orderly and retracements return. CME equity index futures settle at 21:00Z, so the final thirteen hours are closed-market placeholders in which weekend gap exposure accumulates toward the Sunday 22:00Z reopen.
